latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — Caption AI makes adding AI-generated captions to your videos fast and easy.

- Instantly generate 1080p captioned videos by uploading files and describing your needs — no timeline or export settings required.
- Automatic connection and token handling for a smooth, secure setup with 100 free credits for new users.
- Supports quick tasks like adding captions in different languages, exporting in various formats, and managing credits/status, all routed via smart intent recognition.
- Cloud GPU-powered backend processes typical jobs in 30–90 seconds; shorter clips are even faster.
- Handles a wide range of video/audio/image formats, with clear error responses and helpful guidance for common issues.
